title: Dashboard New Customer Action Permission Consistency

items.action: open the Customers page from the Dashboard new-customer quick action
create a customer from the Customers page reached by the Dashboard new-customer quick action

backend.reason: Existing customer authorization remains unchanged and authoritative.

api.reason: No server API contracts change; only Dashboard action visibility is aligned with existing route and page permissions.

tenant_isolation.reason: No backend query or organization-scoping behavior changes.

audit.reason: No mutation or audit behavior changes.

menu.reason: No navigation menu changes are introduced.

route_guard.reason: The /customers route already requires fair_crm.customers.read; CustomersPage already gates creation with fair_crm.customers.create.

forms.reason: No form implementation changes; the existing customer create form gate is reused.

notes: Dashboard previously rendered the Yeni Musteri quick action for every authenticated organization user. The action routes to /customers, which requires fair_crm.customers.read, and its promised create workflow is only available when fair_crm.customers.create is also granted. The Dashboard action now fails closed unless both permissions are present.
